subject.title: fix(model-selection): warn on duplicate model aliases

question: Should duplicate model aliases preserve the shipped last-wins selection while warning, or intentionally change every alias-resolution path to first-wins?
rationale: Both policies are implementable, but changing the selected provider/model for existing configurations is a compatibility and model-routing decision that source inspection cannot authorize.

options.title: Preserve last-wins and warn
options.body: Keep existing routing semantics, centralize collision warnings across direct and indexed resolution, and add regression coverage for all callers.

options.title: Adopt first-wins everywhere
options.body: Change every alias-resolution path consistently and provide explicit upgrade documentation and fresh-install versus upgrade proof for the routing change.

options.title: Reject duplicate aliases
options.body: Make duplicate aliases a validated configuration error with an in-product diagnostic and a doctor-assisted recovery path rather than choosing either entry silently.

recommendation.title: Preserve last-wins and warn
recommendation.body: Keep existing routing semantics, centralize collision warnings across direct and indexed resolution, and add regression coverage for all callers.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work owns the shared alias-index and allowlist resolution behavior affected by this policy choice.
